outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 222 women with previous stillbirth, of whom 145 had a subsequent pregnancy
finding: Pregnancy after stillbirth was associated with increased surveillance and intervention, including higher rates of cesarean delivery, induction of labor, and preterm delivery.
mod_finding: Rates of induction of labor (48.1%) and cesarean delivery (40.5%) were significantly higher than national rates for multiparous women.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery: 37 weeks
